## backdown flag set {#set}

Set a flag on an item.

```text
backdown flag set [OPTIONS] <TARGET> <STATE>
```

### Arguments

`<TARGET>`
: content:<sha256hex>, subject:<key>, entity:<key> or path:<key>.

`<STATE>`
: canonical | duplicate | keep | drop | reviewed | owner-confirmed | mine | not-mine.

### Options

`--canonical <TARGET>`
: For a duplicate: the canonical copy's target.

`--by <BY>`
: Who decided. Default: `user`.

`--note <NOTE>`
: &nbsp;

## backdown flag clear {#clear}

Clear a flag from an item.

```text
backdown flag clear [OPTIONS] <TARGET> <STATE>
```

### Arguments

`<TARGET>`
: &nbsp;

`<STATE>`
: &nbsp;

## backdown flag of {#of}

Show an item's flags.

```text
backdown flag of [OPTIONS] <TARGET>
```

### Arguments

`<TARGET>`
: &nbsp;

### Options

`--json`
: Print it as JSON, for scripts.

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
